title: ItzDaily
body:
ItzDaily is a highly customizable Minecraft daily rewards plugin designed to keep players engaged and rewarded for returning to your server every day. Create unique reward systems, configure rewards to match your server's economy and progression, and provide players with exciting incentives to log in regularly.

Here is all the info you need to use this plugin.
Commands:
- **/daily** - opens menu with player's daily rewards
- **/daily reload** - reloads changes made from config
- **/daily addcommand <1-30 (day)> <command>** - adds new command as a reward
- **/daily addreward <1-30 (day)> hand** - adds held item as a reward
- **/daily listrewards <1-30 (day)>** - lists all rewards for this day
- **/daily removecommand <1-30 (day)> <command index>** - removes command from rewards
- **/daily removeitem <1-30 (day)> <item index>** - removes item from rewards
- **/daily removeplayerdata <player> <currentstreak/full>** - currentstreak = sets player's day to 1, full = fully wipes player's data even with history
- **/daily setdescription <1-30 (day)> <description>** - changes description
- **/daily setmaterial <1-30 (day)>** - sets held item as material

Permissions:
- **itzdaily.open** - allows you to use /daily
- **itzdaily.claim** - allows you to claim daily rewards in /daily
- **itzdaily.reload** - reloads changes made from config
- **itzdaily.admin** - full access

Features:
- Multiple rewards (commands) per each day
- Highly customizable
- 3 different modes for **7/14/30 days**
- Custom streak loss options
- Custom day icons option
- Custom cooldown for rewards

If you want to suggest new ideas, need support or report a bug make sure to join my discord: https://discord.gg/XrBDFYR2aa

I will really appreciate if you leave me a review and give me feedback about the plugin!
(please do not use reviews for reporting bugs! if you need help then join my discord for support)
